en: An old Italian postal card with printed heading 'CARTOLINA POSTALE ITALIANA (CARTE POSTALE D'ITALIE)', the royal coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy in red at the center, and Italian and German postmarks. A red Italian stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark reading 'PISA'. The front is filled with handwritten address text in German, including the recipient's name and address in Heidelberg, Germany.
